mapper.select: select t.FORM_KEY_ from act_hi_taskinst t where t.ID_ = #{taskId}
select ahc.MESSAGE_ from act_hi_comment ahc where ahc.ID_ = #{commentId}

select PROC_INST_ID_ from act_hi_varinst where PROC_INST_ID_ in (select PROC_INST_ID_ from act_hi_varinst where NAME_ = 'workFlowType' and TEXT_ = #{workFlowType}) and NAME_ = 'BUSINESS_KEY' and TEXT_ = #{businessKey}

SELECT b.MESSAGE_ FROM ACT_HI_COMMENT B WHERE B.TIME_> (select nvl(max(A.TIME_),to_date('1990-01-01','yyyy-mm-dd')) FROM ACT_HI_COMMENT A WHERE A.PROC_INST_ID_=B.PROC_INST_ID_ AND A.TYPE_='action' and A.message_='APPROVED_RETURN') AND B.TYPE_='action' and b.proc_inst_id_=#{procInstId} and b.user_id_=#{userId} and rownum=1
